verdict.rationale: FreeAgent ships its own OAuth 2.0 REST API, with production and sandbox endpoints and documented resources for invoices (including reminder, thank-you and logo options), bank transactions and users. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches the UI, and many UI features (payroll, HMRC VAT/Self Assessment filing, Smart Capture, cashflow projections, Amazon integration) have no API evidence. Missing for 10: any documented API-UI parity statement, API coverage of payroll, tax filing, Smart Capture and dashboards, a published OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and independent corroboration.
